one_liner_zh: Palantir EPS大超預期18%，營收年增高達85%顯示AI平台商業化動能爆發。
one_liner_en: Palantir crushed EPS by 18% with explosive 85% revenue growth, signaling booming AI-platform commercialization.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期18.08%且營收年增高達84.71%，成長爆發。
ai_view_zh: 訊號強勁：EPS超預期18%搭配85%營收年增，顯示AIP平台商業化加速、營運槓桿浮現，成長爆發性為本批之最。短期股價有強動能，惟149倍本益比意味市場已定價極高成長，任何放緩都易引發劇烈波動。中期關鍵在商業客戶數與淨擴張率（NRR）能否延續。追蹤指標：商業營收年增、客戶數與合約規模、NRR、營業利潤率與全年指引上修。
ai_view_en: Signal is strong: an 18% EPS beat with 85% revenue growth shows AIP commercialization accelerating and operating leverage emerging, the most explosive growth in this batch. Near-term strong momentum, but a 149x P/E means the market prices in very high growth, so any slowdown can drive sharp volatility. Mid-term the key is whether commercial-customer count and net retention persist. Track: commercial revenue growth, customer count and deal size, NRR, operating margin and guidance raises.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.33美元，超出預期0.28美元，超預期幅度18.08%
營收16.3億美元，年增高達84.71%，為本批成長最強
AIP人工智慧平台帶動商業客戶數與合約規模快速擴張
獲利與營收同步超預期，顯示規模化已現營運槓桿
highlights_en: EPS of $0.33 beat the $0.28 estimate by 18.08%
Revenue of $1.63B grew a remarkable 84.71%, the strongest in this batch
The AIP platform drives rapid expansion in commercial customers and contract size
Earnings and revenue beat together, showing operating leverage as it scales
risks_zh: 本益比149倍極高，估值對成長放緩極度敏感
政府合約占比高，預算與政治週期帶來不確定性
AI題材熱度若退潮，高估值面臨大幅修正風險
risks_en: A 149x P/E is extreme, leaving valuation hypersensitive to any slowdown
Heavy government-contract reliance brings budget and political-cycle uncertainty
If AI enthusiasm cools, the rich valuation faces sharp correction risk
